sentence: This project puts research on bacteriophages from soil into introductory biology courses at a two-year college.
This project builds a method that learns by itself how to combine multimodal data to make healthcare predictions.
This project sets up a mass spectrometer to identify and measure lipids and other metabolites in complex biological samples.
This project supports research on keeping computer systems secure, such as smart manufacturing systems and next-generation wireless networks.
This project uses a low temperature imaging technique to study the edge currents of topological states in two-dimensional materials.
This project develops mathematical methods that make the training of generative artificial intelligence models stable when only data samples are available.
This project explores crossed beams of ultrasound as a noninvasive way to stimulate small spots in the brain.
This project upgrades an array of telescopes so it can record interference patterns at visible and infrared wavelengths at the same time.
This project brings together physicists, mathematicians, logicians, and computer scientists to use quantum theory to solve real-world problems.
This project studies how hidden organic nitrogen in soil changes and moves toward groundwater on farms and prairies.
This project studies how teaching human-centered soft robotics in high school science courses changes the way people see engineering.
This project builds a way to measure how bridges and wind turbines vibrate in three dimensions using stereo cameras on a drone.
This project builds a collection of recorded speech in several low-data languages and uses machine learning to help write down what is said.
This project builds miniaturized power converters using gallium nitride devices to deliver power to AI processors in data centers with less loss.
This project studies how plants and some bacteria break down chemicals called flavonols and use the breakdown products to make other molecules.
This project builds a CRISPR sensor made with 2D materials to detect Salmonella quickly without first amplifying target DNA.
